rules: Each exact name has one declaration owner. Multiple features may contribute content using that name.
Feature deactivation releases its handles/counts/listeners. Resident dictionary registration does not mean the feature is active.
Use tags for semantic membership and routes; use asset references for definitions and typed fields for quantities/order.
Hierarchical matching is opt-in at the consuming API. An exact lookup does not automatically support a mod child.
Place mod identity below the supported semantic parent, for example Damage.Type.Melee.Mod.Author.Pack.Thorn. Do not move the semantic parent below a global Mod root.
GameplayCue descendants are reserved for GAS cues. A cooldown state is a separate contract, even when a legacy cue name contains Cooldown.
Authority and ownership are enforced by the executing system, never by possession of a tag alone.
Gameplay messages are local events. A late subscriber needs a state snapshot before subscribing to changes; the message channel is not replicated storage.
Save and public identities use names, never transient network indices.
Renames retain exact redirects. Do not create redirect chains, loops, self-redirects or active definitions under the old name.
Gameplay feature selection is fixed during a session. Between sessions the product uses name/token encoding so load history cannot reinterpret global indices.
External declarations are denied unless the product publishes the semantic parent in ModTagExtensionRoots. A public API reference is not permission to declare under its namespace.

semantic_review.reason: Ability classification and event consumers coexist. No root-wide equivalence has been established; retain existing serialized identities and inspect the consuming API.
Different systems own state contributions and lifetimes. Root spelling alone is insufficient to merge contracts.
GAS gameplay events and the local typed message router have different payload and delivery contracts.
Catalog identities and setting identifiers must be migrated with their registries, not through a blanket tag rename.
Retained sample identities remain supported while serialized consumers exist.
Keep the engine-required cue root; no automatic conversion of cue names containing Cooldown into gameplay states.

sequence: Each owner retains its own GAS effect/ability-set handle or one loose-tag count.
Releasing owner A must preserve owner B.
Release only owned handles on cancellation, EndPlay or feature deactivation; never set the shared total count to zero.
Read the owning component current state for an initial snapshot.
Register the matching payload type; ExactMatch is the default, PartialMatch includes descendants.
Retain and unregister the listener handle on owner teardown.
Use the explicit networking component/envelope for remote delivery; local BroadcastMessage alone does not replicate.

declaration_policy.identity: ContentId is case-insensitive. Lowercase each segment, then capitalize its first letter; retain hyphens/underscores. Each segment must start with a letter. author.pack maps to Mod.Author.Pack.
declaration_policy.files: Direct Config/Tags/<PluginName>_<Topic>.ini files; at most 32, 256 KiB each and 1 MiB total.
declaration_policy.syntax: Only [/Script/GameplayTags.GameplayTagsList], GameplayTagList=(Tag="...",DevComment="...") and GameplayTagRedirects=(OldTagName="...",NewTagName="..."); no + prefix: these are standalone source lists, not config hierarchy array overrides. Use Unreal serialized field order. No arbitrary settings or array removals.
declaration_policy.redirects: Both names belong to the same ContentId under approved roots. Target is declared by the mod; old name is no longer declared. No chains, cycles, duplicate or self redirects.
declaration_policy.use_existing: Referencing an existing tag does not require permission to redeclare it. Do not copy base definitions into your mod.
declaration_policy.delivery: CookContentMod runs native manifest validation before cook. Receipt v2 hashes ContentId and all delivered tag files. Runtime revalidates ownership and hashes before registration; arbitrary Config files are rejected.
declaration_policy.lifetime: Dictionary entries may stay resident after deactivation. Release effect/count/listener/content handles separately; resident name is never an activation test.
declaration_policy.compatibility: Receipt v1 without loose Config remains supported. New tag declarations require v2.
